comparison.objective: Press opposite-sense drawer-slide releases while pulling the drawer out; candidate registers and secures sensors.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous lever actuation and coordinated extraction versus partial screw release, precision sliding, sensing, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Both levers pressed together, drawer extracted ≥280 mm, released and still 1 s; candidate requires two ≤6 mm registrations held 3 s.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual coordination, but not the same tested ability. Candidate lacks screw torque, slide friction, and numeric drift limits.
